race.comment: PAW TREACLE (1) is in top form lately including a head turning win at Bendigo in 23.80 two back then backing it up with a 24.49 victory at Sale over 435m latest. Expected to push the clock again here. ANALYZATION (8) boasts a strong record this journey with 18 wins and five minors from 31 tries. Missed the frame latest (30.14) when seventh over 515m at Sandown in a Grade 4/5. Can hit the frame with the right run. MAGIC FLETCH (3) has claims fresh from a recent placing.
